title: Path-neutral project configuration manifest
description: Objective: land the immutable production configuration identity the benchmark must bind without exposing physical paths. Deliverable: a canonical ProjectConfigurationManifest producer/codec that hashes authority-relevant project policy, provider/runtime selection, limits, network/isolation, approval defaults and orchestration source identity into settingsDigest, persists/selects it with the daemon project, and exposes a current read edge for benchmark consumers. MEASURED GAP at HEAD 2b15b8f: no ProjectConfigurationManifest, settingsDigest, configuration digest or orchestration SHA production symbol exists anywhere under packages/ or apps/; profileRevisionId is a session/profile ref and cannot substitute. Consumer: task-b937811e8b72459ea169e5fff1238ce1 and downstream confirmatory corpus freeze. NOT in scope: benchmark constants, competitor configuration, physical config paths, corpus bytes, gate scoring, or GO decisions. Owned paths: focused contracts/core/daemon configuration-manifest modules and tests selected after re-measurement; avoid growing existing >250-line files. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test && pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm typecheck.
definitionOfDone: A versioned immutable ProjectConfigurationManifest binds project, authority-relevant policy/configuration values, provider/model/runtime selection refs, concurrency/limit settings, network/isolation and approval defaults, plus exact orchestration source commit; it contains no physical configuration path.

Canonical serialization and settingsDigest cover every declared field, reject accessors/unknown/duplicate/malformed values with stable code/layer, and any byte change alters or invalidates the digest.

The daemon persists/selects the exact manifest for a project and exposes a production current-read edge; absent, stale, conflicting or unreadable data returns explicit UNKNOWN with exact reason code/layer rather than a default manifest.
A compiled bare-specifier consumer test proves the benchmark can read the public contract/current record without deep imports, and persistence/reopen tests prove the selected bytes survive restart.
Generated field/digest sensitivity cases assert a non-zero exact count and mutation drills alter one production canonicalization guard and one current-selection comparison to make named tests red.
Fresh pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test && pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm typecheck exits 0.
taskRails: No physical configuration paths are part of identity; the manifest is path-neutral and source-commit-bound.
Do not use session profileRevisionId as settingsDigest or orchestration SHA.
Missing/unreadable/currentness-conflicting configuration remains UNKNOWN and never inherits defaults as evidence.
Shared contract changes require the full named regression gate.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; the cap is per file.

implementationPlan.description: Before editing, re-measure HEAD and the five owned paths, then require tasks task-0c21ba2f07cc4f4a829e475bbd7f0562 and task-bcea70569f714367b2e50c1734433631 to be DONE on disk: grep the @moe/contracts ProjectConfigurationManifest/parser exports and @moe/core create/encode/decode exports and inspect their handoffs/mutation evidence. Verify the consumer edges again in all three forms required by the rail: apps/daemon/package.json dependencies, the apps/daemon importer in pnpm-lock.yaml, and a uniquely named temporary TypeScript probe inside apps/daemon importing the new symbols from bare @moe/contracts/@moe/core plus SqliteEventStore from bare @moe/store; run the package typecheck and delete the probe in the same try/finally command. If any prerequisite/symbol/edge is absent, report blocked rather than adding a daemon copy. Record the exact verification command's merge-base output before the diff for later path-attributed comparison, and recheck that no active task owns the proposed configuration paths or daemon barrel/surface test.

TDD red: create the focused daemon test through the production public roots. Freeze the APIs as `selectProjectConfiguration(store, unknown)` and `readCurrentProjectConfiguration(store, unknown)`, with an exact selection request (projectId, command/correlation/timestamp, expected aggregate version, canonical manifest bytes) and an exact current-read request (projectId, expectedSettingsDigest). Pin frozen success as SELECTED/CURRENT with DAEMON_VERIFIED durable evidence, exact canonical bytes/manifest/selectionVersion, and every failure as UNKNOWN/NONE with one of PROJECT_CONFIGURATION_ABSENT, PROJECT_CONFIGURATION_STALE, PROJECT_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT, or PROJECT_CONFIGURATION_UNREADABLE at PROJECT_CONFIGURATION_SELECTION plus exact upstream code/layer where another layer refused. Add real file-backed SQLite cases for first select, current read, update, exact replay, replay after a newer selection, CAS loser, close/reopen byte equality, and zero duplicate events; add bounded structural-port cases for stable-tail interleavings/store throws. Add a hand-written forged-record matrix covering event type/schema/aggregate/project/sequence/page shape, missing or mismatched command decision/receipt/request digest/result bytes, and malformed canonical manifest bytes; assert its exact positive case count, exact code/layer/upstream, and no default/authority on every refusal.

Implement the current-read half in one focused production module. Derive one fixed project-scoped configuration-selection aggregate from the already validated projectId; perform a bounded before-version/read-one-latest/after-version loop using `getAggregateVersion` and `readAggregateEvents`, and return CONFLICT if no stable tail is observed. Snapshot store-returned objects/arrays/bytes through own enumerable data descriptors before use. Require one exact `ProjectConfigurationSelected` event/schema/aggregate sequence and resolve its exact `getCommandDecision` record; cross-check command key, target aggregate, EFFECTS_COMMITTED disposition, business event id, request digest, and byte-for-byte decision result/event payload. Decode only through bare-root `decodeProjectConfigurationManifestBytes`, require the embedded projectId to match, then compare the freshly decoded settingsDigest with the caller's expectedSettingsDigest. Map absence, expected-digest mismatch, structural/integrity disagreement, codec refusal, and thrown store faults to the four closed UNKNOWN results without a synthesized manifest. Freeze/detach every returned record and keep the source <=250 physical lines.

Implement selection/write composition in the same module without creating a second authority policy. Exact-snapshot the request and manifest byte array once, decode through @moe/core before touching the store, reject project mismatch, and persist the identical canonical manifest bytes as both the sole `ProjectConfigurationSelected` event payload and committed decision result via `SqliteEventStore.commitExpectedVersionDecision` on the fixed aggregate. Map EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT to PROJECT_CONFIGURATION_STALE, idempotency/identity disagreement to PROJECT_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT, and store faults to PROJECT_CONFIGURATION_UNREADABLE, preserving upstream provenance. On DECIDED and REPLAYED responses, call the production current-read path with the submitted settingsDigest before returning SELECTED so an old replay after a newer selection cannot regain authority. Emit only one event on first acceptance and none on replay/refusal. Add concise TSDoc explaining the latest-stable-tail currentness definition and the self-digest exclusion; create the exact one-line LF bridge `export * from "./project-configuration-selection.ts";`.

Publish the complete runtime/type closure from the @moe/daemon root and update the exact namespace/type assertions, keeping apps/daemon/src/index.ts at or below its pre-task 333 physical lines by consolidating only semantically equivalent adjacent export statements. Complete the public-consumer test with a Windows-safe child `execFile(process.execPath, ['--experimental-strip-types', ...])` smoke: from apps/daemon import only bare @moe/contracts/@moe/core/@moe/daemon/@moe/store roots, create a manifest, select it into a temporary project store, close, reopen, and read the exact current record. Use no shell, set windowsHide, bound timeout/buffers, close all handles before `rmSync` in a finally block, and assert the full result rather than truthiness. Run the reversible currentness mutation drill by removing/inverting the production `decoded.settingsDigest === expectedSettingsDigest` comparison, prove the named stale-replay/current test goes red with its exact code/layer assertion, then restore production bytes and prove green. Inspect task-bcea70569f714367b2e50c1734433631's recorded canonicalization mutation drill rather than modifying its foreign-owned core file.

Run exactly `pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test && pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm typecheck` in the foreground and capture its exit code/output as complete_task evidence. Compare this fresh HEAD output with the merge-base baseline from step 1 and report any foreign failing paths verbatim; owned-package legs must be exit 0 and the new failing-path intersection with the five owned paths must be empty. Also mechanically assert the new production source is <=250 lines, daemon index.ts did not exceed its pre-task 333 lines, the bridge is exact double-quoted LF bytes, both temporary probes/smoke directories are gone, and `git diff --check` plus `git status --porcelain` show no generated evidence or unowned staged paths.

Load adversarial-self-review and read the owned diff as an attacker: replay twice and replay after replacement, two writers at one expected version, head movement on every stable-tail attempt, malformed/proxy/accessor/symbol/sparse/oversized requests and byte views, event/decision transplantation across projects, absent decisions, mutated result bytes, unsupported manifest versions, codec UNKNOWN propagation, closed-store exceptions, and Windows SQLite cleanup. Confirm no physical path, default configuration, profileRevisionId substitution, deep package import, unbounded loop, or caller-owned alias can cross the boundary. If review changes any byte, rerun the exact verification command from the prior step and replace the evidence with the fresh output. Before handoff, inspect the shared index and stage/commit only the five explicit owned paths by pathspec; unstage foreign entries and verify the resulting commit/diff contains nothing else.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: SPIDR split on existing package seams. A single contracts+core+daemon implementation would require at least 12 files once each production module has its required LF bridge, focused package test, and root export; it was split into browser-safe contract task task-0c21ba2f07cc4f4a829e475bbd7f0562, Node/core digest-codec task task-bcea70569f714367b2e50c1734433631, and this final daemon persistence/current-read integration task. Extending core ProjectState was rejected because it would ripple through project validation/reducers/bootstrap/restore and make configuration currentness share an unrelated aggregate. A generic open settings map was rejected because it cannot mechanically prove every authority field is present. New normalized SQLite tables were rejected because the existing event+decision ledger already provides atomic CAS, replay, reopen, and integrity surfaces for one fixed project selection aggregate.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Current-byte measurement at HEAD faf5ee5fb6f21f0b2c1851e5fdd08cdd44fa359a: `rg -n "ProjectConfigurationManifest|settingsDigest|PROJECT_CONFIGURATION|createProjectConfigurationManifest|readCurrentProjectConfiguration|selectProjectConfiguration" packages apps` returned NO_MATCHES, and all three proposed production paths were absent. The pinned design SHA-256 was reverified as 1D9D1EC97D3F07247FBBC088045E0BA2FD6DA8307F10A9026C55106419383191; design lines 57-66, 228, 617-630, 688-712, 811-817, 1135-1139, 1264, and 1271 define the effective limits, approval/network/isolation truth, path-neutral manifest, and benchmark binding. The benchmark spec SHA-256 is A62B90436CC0B911FB28526AF7B7E0F2D1370F6F93DB91C26077F6E2956A589C and lines 101,106,118,354,492 require the model/harness/config triple and settingsDigest/orchestration binding. Dependency-edge measurement: packages/core/package.json declares @moe/contracts; apps/daemon/package.json declares @moe/contracts, @moe/core, and @moe/store; pnpm-lock.yaml importer entries at core 135-139 and daemon 87-112 carry those links. Temporary probes inside packages/core and apps/daemon imported the existing bare roots and `pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck` plus `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` exited 0; both probe files were deleted and `git status` showed no residue. Existing durable patterns are `SqliteEventStore.commitExpectedVersionDecision`, `getAggregateVersion`, `readAggregateEvents`, `getCommandDecision`, and the bounded before/read/after stable-tail loop in document-work-read.ts. Existing line counts: contracts index 155, core index 283, core index-surface test 385, daemon index 333, daemon index-surface test 544; current owned paths were clean.
planningNotes.risks: The two prerequisite symbols are deliberately absent today: do not stub/reimplement them in daemon; this task may start only after task-0c21ba2f07cc4f4a829e475bbd7f0562 and task-bcea70569f714367b2e50c1734433631 are DONE and live bare-root probes pass. task-d23a913f0586431d9dccc0cfd1f66fd5 owns launch-time model/effort evidence; avoid a digest cycle by consuming only the configuration manifest primitive selection refs and never importing runner selection policy. Selection replay is dangerous after a later update: a historical replay is success only if a fresh stable read still equals its settingsDigest. Stable-tail races, mismatched event/decision bytes, project transplant, malformed descriptors, and store throws must remain UNKNOWN. `apps/daemon/src/index.ts` is already over the 250 target but under 400; add the export without increasing its physical line count. task-311adb23a3964146a25fa8bddf7123e9 currently has daemon index-surface work in REVIEW, so recheck ownership/current bytes before editing. Windows smoke cleanup must close SQLite in the child before the parent removes the temp directory; use execFile/argument arrays, windowsHide, and never shell:true.
